badge.description: An icon badge. Image badges are set with social.colibri.beta.role.putBadgeImage. Takes precedence over removeBadge.

hoisted.description: Whether holders are listed separately in the member list.

community.description: The community the role belongs to.

emojiBadge.description: An emoji badge. Cannot be combined with badge. Takes precedence over removeBadge.

mentionable.description: Whether @role mentions resolve to this role.

removeBadge.description: Removes the role's badge, whichever kind it is. Ignored when badge or emojiBadge is also given.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the role.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: RoleNotFound
errors.description: No role exists at the given record key.

errors.name: RoleProtected
errors.description: The role is marked protected and cannot be modified.

errors.name: RoleHierarchy
errors.description: The change would place the role at or above the caller's highest role position, or grants a permission the caller does not hold.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
